material_description: HPCDCM | hierarchical porous carbide-derived carbon monolith: ordered mesoporous SiC monolith (OMSCM, nanocast from polycarbosilane PCS-800 in KIT-6 silica) chlorinated at 800 C for 40 min; tablet-like monolith 8.1 mm diameter x 2.5 mm thick
source_location: Fig. 8a (p. 23898), series HPCDCM (pink circles), marker 1 of 11
